🔥🇲🇽 <u>Morena Mayor of Puerto Aventuras Arrested for Extortion</u>

Quintana Roo's prosecutors arrested Gilberto Gómez Martínez, the Morena mayor of Puerto Aventuras, on a judge's warrant for aggravated extortion, along with his nephew and an official from the town's economic development office. They are accused of threatening a local merchant: pay up, or lose your goods and your business.

🇲🇽🎓 <u>"El Negro" Durazo's Mansion Becomes a Public University</u>

Arturo "El Negro" Durazo ran Mexico City's police under López Portillo and built himself a mansion in Tlalpan that became a byword for that era's corruption. President Sheinbaum announced it will now house a campus of the public Universidad Rosario Castellanos plus a high school, with 150 million pesos for the conversion and classes starting in 2027. 3,067 students have already registered for its five degrees: psychology, law and criminology, administration, tourism and economics.

🔥🇲🇽 "They talk about freedom. Which freedom? The one they have to rant, because the only thing there is, is debate. Censorship? There is none." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, Mañanera, Oct 15, 2026 Sheinbaum said some businessmen "who spend their time ranting through their television network" oppose the government's model: "for the good of all, the poor first," shared prosperity and distribution of wealth. "They want to accumulate more for themselves, and nothing for the people," and they oppose the well-being programs and the wage increase. She said she meets regularly with the Business Coordinating Council and the Mexican Business Council, and sometimes tells them no. One example was a proposal to stop wage increases. The monthly minimum wage has gone from 2,800 pesos in 2018 to more than 13,500 today.

🇲🇽🔍 "There has to be recognition, because there has not been that recognition as such." "The first is recognition by the Mexican State of the forced disappearance of that era, ordered from the highest spheres of power." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, Mañanera, Oct 15, 2026 On Aug 26 a judge ordered the Defense Ministry to hand over information on Alicia de los Ríos, a member of the Liga Comunista 23 de Septiembre who disappeared in 1978. Sheinbaum said the ministry has to respond to the judge. The government has met four times with Eureka, the collective of Rosario Ibarra de Piedra, and is working on three fronts: state recognition, truth and justice, and finding the disappeared. Attorney General Ernestina Godoy appointed a new prosecutor for victims of the Dirty War.

text: 🔥🇲🇽 "We do not want to go back to neoliberalism, never again, never again." "Neoliberalism is over in Mexico, it is not going to come back, because it showed that it impoverishes the people." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, Mañanera, Oct 15, 2026 A reporter cited analysts Guillermo Ortiz and Alejandro Werner ruling out an economic crisis. Ortiz was Zedillo's finance minister during the 1994–95 crisis and the Fobaproa bank bailout. Sheinbaum answered by walking through 36 years of neoliberal governments: De la Madrid's inflation, Salinas selling off public companies, the '94 crisis, Zedillo turning private debt into public debt, Fox overexploiting the Cantarell oil field. "And now those are the ones who come to give us advice."

🔥🇲🇽 "Good thing that it is true there is fiction journalism, or gossip journalism, among the commentocrats." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, Mañanera, Oct 15, 2026 Columnist Jorge Fernández Menéndez claimed that US intelligence detected a leak inside Mexico's National Intelligence Center (CNI) in 2020, and that then-ambassador Christopher Landau demanded the CNI director's removal while López Obrador refused. Sheinbaum put Landau's reply on screen: "At least as far as I am concerned, this report is absolutely false and invented. I never heard of this issue during my time in Mexico, never had occasion to raise it with the then-president, and it never had anything to do with my departure from Mexico." Landau, now US Deputy Secretary of State, also corrected his title.

🇲🇽🏭 "There was a problem in Mexico: cruise ships arrived and nobody bought anything in Mexico." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, Mañanera, Oct 15, 2026 The ships brought food and supplies from their home countries, and tourists bought almost nothing ashore. The government negotiated with the cruise lines: artisans now sell directly at the ports, and ships buy part of their food and supplies in Mexico. Cruise passengers rose from 6.7 million in 2024 to 8.2 million in January–August 2026, and their spending grew 17.3%. Tourism Secretary Josefina Rodríguez reported 67.7 million international travelers (+6.3%) and US$24.152 billion in revenue in the same period, both records.

🇲🇽⚖️ "For those who say there is no democracy in the country: it was a free vote." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, Mañanera, Oct 15, 2026 Most IMSS workers rejected the union's salary agreement in an open consultation. Sheinbaum credited the labor reform passed under López Obrador: workers can now vote on a deal negotiated by their union leadership. "If there had not been that labor reform, this would not have happened." IMSS director Zoé Robledo will open a new working table today and tomorrow for a better offer, with salary but also working conditions. "Nobody is obliged to do the impossible; what is possible, with the greatest benefit for IMSS workers."
